Boutique Hotel Launch Film

A quiet-luxury arrival sequence for destination properties.

YOUR CUSTOMIZED PROMPT

Create a 12-second launch film for [HOTEL] in [DESTINATION]. Open with an atmospheric establishing shot at [TIME], transition to a tactile close-up of [SIGNATURE DETAIL], then reveal [HERO SPACE] with one slow stabilized movement. Guests appear incidental and natural. Sound: local ambience, soft water and wind. Color grade: [PALETTE]. Sophisticated quiet-luxury pacing, 16:9, no captions or generic stock transitions.

How to use it

  1. Replace the variables using the fields above.
  2. Copy the completed prompt into Veo or a compatible model.
  3. Review at full resolution and adjust one decision at a time.
EDITORIAL GUIDANCE

Getting a result you can use

Treat this template as a controlled creative brief. Preserve critical source details, make one major change at a time and inspect the final result before commercial use.

Common mistakes

Avoid vague quality words, conflicting styles and large generic negative-prompt lists. State the result, protected details and final placement clearly.

Model behavior changes over time. Review identity, anatomy, text, labels, reflections and rights before publishing.
